    "parenttype": "User",
    "role": ["in", ['BOM Team', 'System Manager']],
})
if not allowed:
    frappe.throw("You don't have access to this data.")

today = frappe.utils.nowdate()
part = frappe.form_dict.get("part") or "queue"

if part == "counts":
    prods = frappe.db.sql("""select pl.name 
    from `tabProduct Library` pl
    where ifnull(pl.fg_item, '') != ''
      and not exists (
          select 1 from `tabBOM` b
          where b.item = pl.fg_item and b.is_active = 1 and b.docstatus = 1
      )
""")
    sheets = frappe.db.sql("""select cs.name 
    from `tabCost Sheet` cs
    where cs.docstatus = 1
      and not exists (
          select 1 from `tabSavinda Quotation` sq
          where sq.cost_sheet = cs.name and sq.docstatus < 2
      )
""")
    frappe.response["message"] = {
        "products": [r[0] for r in prods],
        "cost_sheets": [r[0] for r in sheets],
    }

elif part == "cost_sheets":
    rows = frappe.db.sql("""
        select cs.name, cs.customer_name, cs.subject, cs.sales_person, cs.pricing_type, cs.creation
        
    from `tabCost Sheet` cs
    where cs.docstatus = 1
      and not exists (
          select 1 from `tabSavinda Quotation` sq
          where sq.cost_sheet = cs.name and sq.docstatus < 2
      )

        order by cs.creation asc
        limit 200
    """, as_dict=True)
    emp_ids = list({r.sales_person: 1 for r in rows if r.sales_person}.keys())
    emp_names = {}
    for e in frappe.get_all("Employee", filters={"name": ["in", emp_ids or ["-"]]},
                            fields=["name", "employee_name"]):
        emp_names[e.name] = e.employee_name
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        out.append({
            "name": r.name,
            "customer": r.customer_name or "",
            "subject": r.subject or "",
            "sales_person": emp_names.get(r.sales_person, r.sales_person or ""),
            "pricing_type": r.pricing_type or "",
            "days": frappe.utils.date_diff(today, r.creation),
        })
    frappe.response["message"] = {"rows": out}

else:
    items = []

    # Job tickets with items pending BOM
    tickets = frappe.get_all(
        "Production Plan",
        filters={"custom_needs_bom": 1, "docstatus": ["<", 2]},
        fields=["name", "custom_customer_name", "custom_job_title", "custom_req_date",
                "custom_sales_order", "custom_pricing_type"],
        limit_page_length=100,
    )
    t_names = [t.name for t in tickets]
    pending = {}
    first_so = {}
    for row in frappe.get_all(
        "Production Plan Item",
        filters={"parent": ["in", t_names or ["-"]], "parenttype": "Production Plan"},
        fields=["parent", "bom_no", "sales_order"],
    ):
        if not row.bom_no:
            pending[row.parent] = pending.get(row.parent, 0) + 1
        if row.sales_order and row.parent not in first_so:
            first_so[row.parent] = row.sales_order
    for t in tickets:
        days = None
        if t.custom_req_date:
            days = frappe.utils.date_diff(t.custom_req_date, today)
        items.append({
            "kind": "ticket",
            "name": t.name,
            "customer": t.custom_customer_name or "",
            "title": t.custom_job_title or "",
            "pricing_type": t.custom_pricing_type or "",
            "days_left": days,
            "so": t.custom_sales_order or first_so.get(t.name, ""),
            "pending": pending.get(t.name, 0),
            "group": 0,
            "sort": days if days is not None else 9999,
        })

    # NPD requests waiting for BOM confirmation
    for n in frappe.get_all(
        "NPD Request",
        filters={"docstatus": 1, "bom_confirmed": 0},
        fields=["name", "customer_name", "job_title", "required_date", "artwork_status"],
        limit_page_length=100,
    ):
        days = None
        if n.required_date:
            days = frappe.utils.date_diff(n.required_date, today)
        items.append({
            "kind": "npd",
            "name": n.name,
            "customer": n.customer_name or "",
            "title": n.job_title or "",
            "artwork_status": n.artwork_status or "",
            "days_left": days,
            "group": 0,
            "sort": days if days is not None else 9999,
        })

    # Product Library entries whose FG item has no active BOM
    prods = frappe.db.sql("""
        select pl.name, pl.product_name, pl.customer, pl.fg_item, pl.approval_status, pl.modified
        
    from `tabProduct Library` pl
    where ifnull(pl.fg_item, '') != ''
      and not exists (
          select 1 from `tabBOM` b
          where b.item = pl.fg_item and b.is_active = 1 and b.docstatus = 1
      )

        order by pl.modified asc
        limit 100
    """, as_dict=True)
    fg_items = [p.fg_item for p in prods]
    configs = {}
    for c in frappe.get_all("BOM Builder Config", filters={"name": ["in", fg_items or ["-"]]},
                            fields=["name"]):
        configs[c.name] = 1
    for p in prods:
        age = frappe.utils.date_diff(today, p.modified)
        saved = 1 if p.fg_item in configs else 0
        items.append({
            "kind": "product",
            "name": p.name,
            "product_name": p.product_name or "",
            "customer": p.customer or "",
            "fg_item": p.fg_item,
            "approval_status": p.approval_status or "",
            "config_saved": saved,
            "age": age,
            "group": 1 if saved else 2,
            "sort": -age,
        })

    items = sorted(items, key=lambda i: (i["group"], i["sort"]))
    frappe.response["message"] = {
        "items": items,
        "counts": {
            "ticket": len([i for i in items if i["kind"] == "ticket"]),
            "npd": len([i for i in items if i["kind"] == "npd"]),
            "product": len([i for i in items if i["kind"] == "product"]),
        },
    }

      and so.status in ('To Deliver and Bill', 'To Deliver')
      and not exists (
          select 1
          from `tabProduction Plan Sales Order` ppso
          inner join `tabProduction Plan` pp on pp.name = ppso.parent
          where ppso.sales_order = so.name and pp.docstatus < 2

          from `tabProduction Plan` pp2
          where pp2.custom_sales_order = so.name and pp2.docstatus < 2
      )
""")

    result["names"] = names
